annotations.title: Tweak one existing element (merge changed fields)

description: Change fields on the element with the given id by merging in a partial element — only the keys you include change. The id may be any element ANYWHERE in the tree, including one nested inside a group (or its mask). Pass a whole nested value (e.g. a new `keyframe_animations` array) to replace that key; set a key to null to remove it. This is for TWEAKING an existing composition. To create a composition or change many elements at once, edit the JSON and call set_project instead. The result is re-validated before being accepted.

id.description: The id of the element to edit.

patch.description: Partial element: the fields to change. Omitted keys are left as-is; a key set to null is removed.

project_id.description: Which project to act on — the id returned by create_project / set_project / create_promo / load_project. ALWAYS pass it once a project exists in this conversation; omitting it on a build tool creates a brand-new project. (Omit only on the local stdio server working a single project.)
